She skips up to a sunny clearing, climbs on top of her tiny soap box and takes a deep breath. With a beaming, toothy smile she thrusts her sign out in front of her reading "Bend me over and be my dragon trainer", presenting her plea for all to see. The shortstack kobold's high-pitched voice rings loud and clear as she calls out with eyes shining like bright blue stars of hope:*

"Good morning everyone! My name's Smolder and I need a master! I was abandoned by my last one but I promise I'm a reeeal good servant! I'm very soft and give the best snuggles everl! For a second she looks as if she might cry, almost dropping her sign. But then she makes her eyes as big and shiny as possible, holding her sign up higher.
